screen.rationale: Styrylpyrene-telechelic PEG step-growth polymer P1 (Mn 60 000, Mw 100 000 g/mol before) is cyclodepolymerized under a 410 nm violet LED (qualifies for E3), but the after-irradiation outcome is given only as SEC traces in figures/ESI and qualitative statements (cyclic oligomers DP 1-3); no Mn/Mw/Mp after or product yield is printed in text or tables.

excluded_observations.what: Violet LED (410 nm) cyclodepolymerization of P1 at 0.05 and 20 mg/mL
excluded_observations.why: Only qualitative (cyclic oligomers after 30 min; DP 1-3 after 24 h); molar masses only in Fig. 3 and ESI.

excluded_observations.what: UVB (330 nm) depolymerization of P1 and P1', P1''
Blue light (>430 nm) on P1, 90 min
excluded_observations.why: No depolymerization; qualitative, values in ESI figure.

excluded_observations.what: Ambient laboratory light (1 week, 25 d) and direct sunlight (5 s, 4 min)
excluded_observations.why: Qualitative outcome only (SEC traces in ESI/Fig. 4).
excluded_observations.loc: Results and discussion > Depolymerization under ambient conditions ¶1

excluded_observations.why: Before-irradiation values only; no matching after values.
